title: Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Return Policy Schedule
content:
Items bought through Ridgeline Orders & Delivery have a return window set by item category, in calendar days counted from fulfillment; a category whose window is 0 is not returnable.

## Return windows by item category (calendar days from fulfillment)

| Item category | Ridgeline Ship to Home | Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | Ridgeline Ship to Store | Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| General merchandise | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Furniture and rugs | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Gas-powered equipment | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Generators | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Major appliances | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Live plants | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Cut-to-length items | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) |
| Final sale items | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) |

## Return fees and refunds of the delivery charge

| Fulfillment program | Return by mail with a prepaid label | Mail-return label charge | Home pickup return charge | Return fees waived for a defective, damaged-in-delivery or wrong item | Return reasons for which the delivery charge is refunded with the return |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | Allowed | $6.99 | $0.00 | Yes | Defective; damaged in delivery; wrong item |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | Not allowed | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | Defective; damaged in delivery; wrong item |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | Not allowed | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | Defective; damaged in delivery; wrong item |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | Not allowed | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | Defective; damaged in delivery; wrong item |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | Not allowed | $0.00 | $79.00 | Yes | Defective; damaged in delivery; wrong item |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | Not allowed | $0.00 | $79.00 | Yes | Defective; damaged in delivery; wrong item |

The mail-return label charge is deducted from a mail return, and the home pickup return charge applies to picking a returned item up from the home, in each case unless the item is defective, damaged or wrong. A return made because the customer changed their mind is not among the reasons for which the delivery charge is refunded.

## Schedule readings (illustrative returns)

| Return | Window | Label or pickup charge | Delivery charge refunded with the return |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home general merchandise item returned by mail, customer changed their mind | 90 days | $6.99 label charge deducted | No |
| Ridgeline Ship to Home item returned by mail as a wrong item | per its category | None, waived | Yes |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery furniture item picked up from the home, damaged in delivery | 30 days | None, waived | Yes |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away major appliance picked up from the home, customer changed their mind | 30 days | $79.00 pickup charge | No |
| Cut-to-length item under any program | not returnable | not applicable | not applicable |
